newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin recovering well - Interfax quotes official.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin recovering well - Interfax quotes official.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin appears to be recovering well from pneumonia, Interfax news agency said on Tuesday, quoting a Russian official who met the president in the morning.

Ivan Korotchenya, who coordinates Russian policy toward the former Soviet republics, said his meeting with Yeltsin had been captured by television and stills photographers. Yeltsin gave the impression of a person who was "recovering normally".
Yeltsin, 65, has not been seen on television since he was taken ill on January 6. Aides say he visited the Kremlin on Tuesday, his second trip there since he fell ill with pneumonia.
